The ropeway was suspended and you rode the bus instead? Your Hakone Freepass may owe you money: on the digital pass the unused ropeway part is ¥1,640 back for an adult 2-day pass 👇

💸 One quick question at the station gate could pay for lunch. Here's how 👉 https://japanbystation.com/hakone-ropeway-closed-plan-b

❌ THE MISTAKE

Most people with a Freepass shrug when the gondolas stop, ride the bus and go home. The pass is collected at the last station and that's it.

✅ THE FIX

Odakyu's rule is simple: if a service was suspended and you didn't use it, that part is refunded at your last station. On the digital Freepass the amounts are written down: ¥1,640 for the ropeway on a 2-day adult pass (¥1,750 on a 3-day), ¥820 if only one section was closed, and another ¥1,180 if the Lake Ashi cruise was stopped too.

🗓️ PLANNED CLOSURES TO KNOW

Part of the ropeway is shut for maintenance from 7 to 24 December 2026, and another section from 12 January to 26 February 2027. Replacement buses run about every 15 minutes for people with valid tickets, but Odakyu expects them to be crowded.

🚌 AND THE DAY ITSELF?

Still worth it. From Gora, the lake is about 20 minutes away by bus.

👉 The bus route from Gora to the lake, lunch stops and when to move the day instead:
